content: Sauga etegana Yehoba i baek Yona, Amitai natuna elana i ba,
“Nu na Ninibe panuwa bwabwatana, ge nu papaatena nu ba nau na lahel, kaiwena wali ginol nanakina i bwata matawa.”

Yaa Yona nuwana Yehoba ni lou luwai ge ni na Sipein. Inoke i na i lau panuwa Yopa, waga etegana i pwawa i nana labi o elana. Yaka wana kamwasa i pwamola, inoke i gaiha ge i kuki tage ni na Sipein ge ana bwaga ni gan Yehoba elana.
Yaka abwe Yehoba mana bwabwatana hot i patowa hoga pwatanaa. Wowol ana gasisi kaiwena kelaubwa waga ni pasamwalekaleka.

Waga ana totuwalali gegewel hi lovakun, inoke maisena maisena labe kaiwena hi yoga wali yabowaineyau elal. Inoke usan toto hi usan hi yoho palo hogaa, yaka waga ni mweyaha. Yaa Yona iyoho waga gamwanaa ge i kenu mati.
Abwe kapten i na elana ge i ba, “Gan, ga i ola ge u kenu mati? U lut ge u awanun wam yabowaine elana! Tab eba ni nuwanakagila ge ni pwamwalila.”
Waga ana totuwalali hi pebaaba-agil hi ola, “Sula ta ab
ge ta loyaan henala wana gegi ge nak ya i masal.” Inoke sula hi ab ge Yona hi pwawa.
Yaka hi nel elana hi ba, “U ba bubun eliyama. Owa wam gegi kaiwena nak ya i masal eliyala o nigeya? Hauna wam tuwalali? Hauna labi elana u noem? Hapanuwa gamagalina owa?”
Inoke analiya i lahe i ba, “Nau Hibilu gamagalina, ya kululu Yehoba, Yabowaine labulabumwa, iya panuwa ge hoga ali toginol.”
Inoke hi lovakun nabi. He hi atena te Yehoba i lou luwai, kaiwena iyaka wali wasa i pek ola. Inoke hi baek elana hi ba, “Ga i ola ge u ginol ola?”
Yaa wowol iyaka i gagasisi nawa, inoke hi baek elana hi ba, “Hauna gun naha ginol eliyam ge wowol ya ni mowasi?”
Yona i baek elal i ba, “Ku alipalowau hogaa inoke ni mainum. Ya atena nau no gegi kaiwena, heiya te wowol bwabwatana ya i masal eliyamiu.”
He totuwalali nige nuwaliya i oola, yaka hi logasisi tage waga nihi leva tukan panuwaa. Yaa nige bosowailiya, kaiwena wowol iyaka i gasisi hot.

Inoke hi yoga ha Yehoba elana hi ba, “Oo Yehoba, ha awanun elam, bahi nu babaa naha yayaomal kaiwena tau ya yawalina ha apanak. Bahi nu babaa tage gegi i minaa eliyama kaiwena tau etegana ha payaomal. Bahi nu lalahema, kaiwena owa u ba te wowol ya i masal.”
Inoke Yona hi ahe ge hi alipalo hogaa, yaka abwe wowol bwabwatana i mowasi ge i mainum.
Ginol o kaiwena totuwalali Yehoba hi lovakunan nabiyan, inoke bwasumu etega hi powonan elana ge hi bateli nihi kukululu eliyana.
Inoke Yehoba moti bwabwatana etegana i patuna i na Yona i tinon, ge i miminaa tinena gamwanaa lan eton ge bulin eton.

footnotes.text: Sula abab iya siba ginoginolina etega ge eliyana i bosowaina bugul misusumena ta atena.
